text:
chris.t: Polaris just pinged — NL customs flagged a pallet for serial mismatch. Holding 10 H100s (AWB PLR-88001). Could hit eu-prod next 24h. Ideas?

meera.p: which serials and why mismatch? any quick release path?

vendor-polaris: customs flagged 4 units as "re-marked" due to label discrepancy vs OEM manifest. We can provide OEM CO + trace but OEM turnaround is ~48h. Local broker can do provisional release on bond for ~\u20ac2.9k with 6-8h release.

ops-bot: cluster forecast: eu pool short ~7 H100-equivalents in 30h. p99 latency +10% on realtime features. Recommend loaners or failover to dedicated fleet.

logistics-max: we have 5 loaners at FRA staging and 3 in LHR hot-rack. Can ship same-day if vendor issues loaner AWB/CI marked "temporary loan" and we provide return PO. Forwarder quote for direct loaner door: \u20ac5.2k (12-16h). Broker provisional release \u20ac2.9k (6-8h).

meera.p: vendor, can you split the shipment (original continues) and send loaners separately?

vendor-polaris: yes we can split. We'll create LOAN-PLR-331 AWB and CI marked "TEMP LOAN - RETURN REQUIRED". Need signed return PO from Redwood. Can dispatch in ~5h after PO.

procurement-jen: procurement ok to sign emergency PO up to \u20ac6k if ops confirms critical.

finance-luisa: vendor offered \u20ac1k credit toward customs fee. Finance can cover up to \u20ac3.5k emergency without exec approval if ops declares urgent.

chris.t: ops-bot, confirm critical?

ops-bot: declared critical per thresholds (latency + degradation). Approve emergency measures.

meera.p: I'll sign return PO and SLA. Vendor, send SLA template now and attach refurb trace if available.

vendor-polaris: SLA link sent: https://vendor.polaris/sla-loan.pdf. Starting LOAN AWB LOAN-PLR-331, tentative pickup 5-6h. Attaching refurb trace PDF after PO.

warehouse-fra: prepping 5 loaners for shipment. QA note: 2 units show elevated fan cycles; bench will run 20m burn. CSV template: `SERIAL,MODEL,LOAN_AWB,RETURN_AWB,CONDITION`

logistics-max: booking standby with SkyRapid at \u20ac5.2k in case vendor pickup slips beyond 6h.

finance-luisa: will pre-issue emergency payment up to \u20ac3.5k. If broker route used and cost > \u20ac3.5k procurement must escalate.

chris.t: Recap: (1) meera to sign return PO/SLA; (2) vendor to issue LOAN-PLR-331 and include OEM trace; (3) warehouse run QA and prep RMA CSV; (4) logistics to standby SkyRapid if pickup >6h; (5) finance to release emergency up to \u20ac3.5k. I'll follow up in 3h.
